ruleDefinitions.name: Office Macro File Download
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of a new office macro files on the systems via an application (browser, mail client).

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\RuntimeBroker\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\outlook\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\thunderbird\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\brave\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\chrome\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\firefox\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\iexplore\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\maxthon\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\MicrosoftEdge\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msedge\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msedgewebview2\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\opera\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\safari\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\seamonkey\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\vivaldi\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\whale\\\.exe$")) AND ((file_path = RGX("\\\.docm$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.dotm$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.xlsm$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.xltm$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.potm$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.pptm$")) OR (file_path = RGX(".*\\\.docm\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.dotm\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.xlsm\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.xltm\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.potm\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.pptm\\:Zone.*"))))
